subject: Next steps: buying committee map + PO / onboarding milestones

Cc: Samir Desai <s.desai@finopsco.com>

Subject: Follow-up & quick clarifications from today

Laura — thanks again for a clear demo this morning. The team found the latency/cost breakdowns helpful. Per our rapid internal sync, I wanted to capture a few items so we can move procurement and security checks along: 

1) Buying committee: I can confirm the stakeholders we expect to be involved: myself (Product lead), Samir (Sourcing / procurement), Priya Kapoor (Security & compliance), and Marcus Lee (Finance — invoice/PO sign-off). Can you confirm which of these maps to typical Redwood contacts (e.g., who we should loop for security questionnaire answers vs commercial)?

2) Procurement ask: we will need a vendor onboarding form + W9 and any data-processing addenda you have. Our procurement team also asks for target invoice terms (Net 30 / Net 45), and whether Redwood requires a signed SOW or simply a subscription/order form.

3) Timeline: target for purchase-complete is end of Nov so we can start a pilot in early Dec. Is that realistic given you have dedicated capacity options?

4) Next steps: Could you send a short mutual action plan with owners/dates? Also attaching the internal onboarding checklist so you can see the fields we capture.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

— Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product, FinOpsCo
elena.morales@finopsco.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Samir Desai <s.desai@finopsco.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & quick clarifications from today

Elena — really appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

On buying committee: good to know the names. Internal mapping:
- Security & compliance questions -> marissa_cole (she owns SOC 2 & DPA responses)
- Procurement / PO coordination -> ben_carter (handles vendor onboarding + invoices)
- Commercial / pricing deviations -> laura_bennett (me)

Procurement docs we can provide (I attached stubs): vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, W9.pdf, and a standard Redwood DPA we use for hosted customers. For SOW vs order form: typically we do an order form for hosted subscriptions; SOWs are used for services or pilot professional services. If you need a signature flow, we can generate an order form with term and seat/throughput lines. Our standard invoice terms are Net 30; Net 45 can be accommodated by exception (please flag in the mutual action plan).

Timeline & capacity: Dedicated pools can be reserved with a 2–3 week lead time for standard GPU profiles; private/VPC/on-prem takes longer. For a pilot in early Dec, we should aim to finalize commercials and PO by mid-November.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, SOW-draft-v2.docx (draft order form attached for template).

Next steps I suggest:
- I will draft a 1-page mutual action plan with owners/dates and share by EOD Monday.
- Ben, can you confirm typical invoice contact info and whether Redwood can accept a PO referencing the Redwood subscription ID (yes/no)?
- Marissa, I'll loop you for the DPA/SOC 2 questions — Elena listed Priya as security contact; can you confirm what evidence artifacts you can provide?

If useful, I'm happy to join a short call with the procurement/security folks next week — propose Wed 10/21 10am PT.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, SOW-draft-v2.docx

From: Samir Desai <s.desai@finopsco.com>

Thanks — looping procurement. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Preferred invoice terms: Net 45 is our standard for new vendors, but we can accept Net 30 for strategic pilot agreements if finance agrees. I'll confirm with Marcus.
- PO process: We typically issue a PO number once legal approves the DPA and commercial terms. PO will reference the subscription/order form number you give us.
- Vendor onboarding: we need a completed vendor_onboarding_form (fields: legal name, tax id, remittance address, bank ACH details optional) + W9. Could you confirm Redwood's remittance address and whether you support ACH?

Happy to take a 20-min call to walk through our checklist — how does 10/21 10am PT look?

— Samir
Samir Desai
Sourcing Manager, FinOpsCo
procurement@finopsco.com

- PO handling: we can accept a PO that references the Redwood subscription/order form number. We also support line-item POs for annual reserved capacity.
- Invoice terms: Ben, please confirm whether Net 45 is an option for this customer or whether we should request Net 30 and use a one-time payment schedule to accommodate their finance preferences.
- DPA / evidence: Marissa, I'll share Priya's contact as provided by Elena; please prepare the SOC 2 summary + DPA redline guidance.

- Marissa: assemble SOC 2 summary + DPA artifact list; indicate any items that need >2 weeks to produce (ETA 10/25).
- Elena / Samir: return completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and W9 (ETA 10/29 to keep mid-Nov timeline).

We'll plan the 10/21 10am PT sync for detailed procurement questions — I'll send the calendar invite once Ben confirms availability.

Thanks all — looking forward to making this timeline work.

Laura
